headline: Approved seven budget amendments totaling $2,267,709.97 for sewer projects, opioid recovery services, hazmat training, and other city programs.
summary: The committee approved funding transfers and expenditures for several Capital Improvement Program items, including sewer system upgrades, the 200 Elm St. Opioid and Substance Use Recovery Service Expansion, FY25 Hazmat Training, Community Health Workers CRU Funding, and FY27 Household Hazardous Waste Collection. Several reports were also voted to be expedited to the full Board.

transcript:
## COMMITTEE ON COMMUNITY IMPROVEMENT

October 6, 2026 at 5:00 PM

Chairman Burkush called the meeting to order.

The Clerk called the roll.

Present: Aldermen Burkush, Vincent, Barry, Goonan, Terrio

1. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorization providing for the acceptance and expenditure of funds in the amount of $106,697.19 for CIP 711124 Solids Disposal Master Plan.

On motion of Alderman Barry , duly seconded by Alderman Vincent , it was voted to approve.

On motion of Alderman Vincent , duly seconded by Alderman Barry , it was voted to expedite the committee’s report to the full Board.

2. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorizations providing for the transfer and expenditure of funds in the amount of $469,567.03 for CIP 710824 Secondary Clarifier Design and Construction.

On motion of Alderman Barry , duly seconded by Alderman Goonan , it was voted to approve.

On motion of Alderman Barry , duly seconded by Alderman Vincent , it was voted to expedite the committee’s report to the full Board.

3. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorizations providing for the transfer and expenditure of funds in the amount of $1,630,167.75 for CIP 711323 Amoskeag EB & Canal Ramp Design and Construction.

On motion of Alderman Barry , duly seconded by Alderman Vincent , it was voted to approve.

4. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorization providing for the acceptance and expenditure of funds in the amount of $15,000 for CIP C160060427 200 Elm St. Opioid and Substance Use Recovery Service Expansion.

On motion of Alderman Barry , duly seconded by Alderman Goonan , it was voted to approve.

On motion of Alderman Vincent , duly seconded by Alderman Barry , it was voted to expedite the committee’s report to the full Board.

October 6, 2026 COMMITTEE ON COMMUNITY IMPROVEMENT

5. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorization providing for the acceptance and expenditure of funds in the amount of $15,833 for CIP C300040727 FY25 Hazmat Training.

On motion of Alderman Goonan , duly seconded by Alderman Vincent , it was voted to approve.

6. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorizations providing for the transfer and expenditure of funds in the amount of $10,000 for CIP C410020327 Community Health Workers CRU Funding.

On motion of Alderman Goonan , duly seconded by Alderman Barry , it was voted to approve.

7. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorization providing for the acceptance and expenditure of funds in the amount of $20,445 for CIP C500070527 FY27 Household Hazardous Waste Collection.

On motion of Alderman Vincent , duly seconded by Alderman Barry , it was voted to approve.

There being no further business, on motion of Alderman Vincent , duly seconded by

Alderman Goonan , it was voted to adjourn.

A True Record. Attest.

Clerk of Committee
